review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 5 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. A fit-out image also appears in the Ayala update and was excluded from both galleries.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 3 and 8. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 2850 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 8 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. Some totals differ from rounded component sums by 0.01 sq ft. The original printed totals are shown.
